reason: The README describes an AI agent skill for reproducing an existing Android feature in another project, including business logic, UI, related pages, resources, and implementation validation; code generation is the primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 一个指导 AI 编程代理依据现有 Android 实现，在目标项目中复刻功能逻辑、界面、相关页面和可复用资源的技能。
summaries.en: An agent skill that guides AI coding tools to reproduce an existing Android feature’s behavior, UI, related pages, and reusable resources in a target project.

capabilities: guides an AI agent to implement Android feature behavior in a target project
guides reproduction of UI layouts, styling, and reusable resources
guides tracing feature entry points and related pages
summarizes changed files, validation, and remaining gaps
